Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Jangaon District for filling up vacant posts in the region.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced in this notification?
faq.answer: The official notification has been released for the Data Entry Operator position under Jangaon District.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Data Entry Operator post in this recruitment notification cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Data Entry Operator post is 08-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Data Entry Operator post must possess Any Degree & DCA with MS-Office as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates is set between Min: 18, Max: 46 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for Jangaon District Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates must send their filled applications via post or in person.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The filled application form along with self-attested copies of certificates should be submitted to the District Panchayat Officer, Jangaon.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and website?
faq.answer: You can find all official details and download forms from the official website at https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in.
